evidence_coverage.note: Real facts present in the telemetry graph that the explanation never referenced -- not wrong, just not accounted for. An analyst's reasoning can be fully TRUE and still incomplete.

evidence_completeness.note: Unusually large gaps between consecutive recorded events, using a simple fixed-threshold heuristic. This does NOT detect or claim evidence tampering/deletion -- it cannot see evidence that left no trace at all. It only flags a statistical property of the timestamps that ARE present, as a prompt for human review.
